dslRule:
<!id: sanitize-code-mining-label>
<!description: Sanitize code mining labels obtained from Annotation.getText() by replacing newline characters with spaces using the helper method, ensuring better display.>
<!severity: HINT>

setLabel($annotationInstance.getText()) ::
  inClass("org.eclipse.ui.internal.editors.text.codemining.annotation.AnnotationCodeMining") &&
  instanceof($annotationInstance, "org.eclipse.jface.text.source.Annotation")
=>
setLabel(org.eclipse.ui.internal.editors.text.codemining.annotation.AnnotationCodeMining.sanitizeLabel($annotationInstance.getText()))
;;
summary: Wrap calls to setLabel with the sanitizeLabel helper method within the AnnotationCodeMining class to ensure labels are sanitized.
